products.title: Patchouli Picante
products.body_html: A bright and vibrant interpretation of patchouli, lifted by sparkling grapefruit, pink pepper and aromatic spices. Airy marine nuances and luminous florals bring a crisp, refreshing character before the fragrance settles into smooth patchouli, soft amber and woody notes. Fresh yet distinctive, Patchouli Picante leaves a lively, lightly spiced trail with an elegant earthy depth.

products.title: Katana Imperium Oil
products.body_html: A limited edition forged in oud. Five distinct oud oils define the composition — including rare wild Silani and Borneo — chosen for depth and character. The woods unfold deliberately with smoke and resin. A precise touch of grapefruit cuts the opening, while warm amber rests beneath. Katana in its most disciplined form — composed, powerful, guided by a warrior’s quiet focus

products.title: Obsidian Bloom Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Emerging from the depths where fire meets stone, Obsidian Bloom is a rare beauty born of darkness. Ancient oud weaves through shadows, entwined with earthy patchouli and delicate floral whispers, deep and untamed. A burst of pineapple fractures the abyss, its golden light flickering before vanishing into the night. Sandalwood softens the edges, turning fire into silk, stone into velvet—where beauty rises from the void, lingering in the unseen.

products.title: Ebony Euphoria Oil
products.body_html: A decadent dance of pure oud and indulgence, where the earthiness of rare woods meets the seductive embrace of dark chocolate. Rich and velvety, the chocolate weaves through zesty orange and the playful sweetness of ripe strawberry, creating an irresistible harmony. Prunes lend their luscious, sun-soaked depth, wrapping the fragrance in a tender, fruity caress. Each drop of Ebony Euphoria is a celebration of gourmand sensuality and timeless oud.

products.title: Thoughtful gifting made easy!
products.body_html: Wondering what to gift to your family, friends, colleagues? Spending too much time browsing for gifts? What better gift than products from Oud Factory, a gift one can open again & again.

products.title: Dōkutsu Kanam Oil
products.body_html: ّIgnited from my deep love for oud and cardamom, this complex composition of spices gently softened with vanilla and tonka notes laying on a bed of the finest quality oud oils is breathtaking. Dōkutsu meaning ‘cave’ refers directly to a cave called Kanam in the heart of Cardamom mountain, situated in the midst of the agarwood jungles of Cambodia

products.title: Hotondo Cambodi Oud Oil
products.body_html: A limited-edition creation I made through my deep love for pure aged Cambodian oud oil.  for years it’s been very difficult to find that rustic almost hypnotizing note I’ve been searching for, so I made it my mission to design the closest possible scent using only pure agarwood oils in the process and nothing else, and I named it Hotondo “almost” Cambodi.

products.title: Harukaze Parfum
products.body_html: A versatile creation inspired by coastal winds, Harukaze evokes the ocean breeze on a midsummer day, celebrating the fresh reflections of zesty redolences combined with the delicate accords of musk, the richness of ambergris and the vibrance of patchouli.  This is the essence of elegance, representing an intoxicating, but yet luminous side of bergamot with the fresh aromas of the woods interpreted my way.

products.title: Encens Noir Parfum
products.body_html: A royal journey starting with the most precious notes, a route of treasures, a place that has not been explored before.  This creation embodies my passion for a frankincense perfume that illustrates the beautiful unseen rich lands of Arabia, its captivating and mysterious composition is a world of discovery that will leave your imagination in awe.

products.title: Amour Mysterieux Parfum
products.body_html: A sensual tantalizing perfume story between sweet and spice, light and dark, pain and hope. A musky, woody, slightly floral aroma infused with the powerful notes of pink pepper, all held together with the sweet notes of vanilla and tonka bean. Its unique adversity is gradually softened by the blooms of hope in a mystery love story.

products.title: Akai Kemuri Parfum
products.body_html: Is a perfect balance between strength and vulnerability, a cloud of fragrant sweet smoke, a creation that is made to capture the elegant and mystifying aroma of tobacco leaves, warm honeyed nuances, all wrapped in a bouquet of floral winds.

products.title: Fiamma Nera
products.body_html:
Fly through the black flames of a deep addiction of precious saffron notes and aged ouds; an experience that evokes memories of Middle Eastern traditions, elaborating the meaning of oriental perfumery. Fiamma Nera is a journey that will be remembered by everyone.

 

Contents: 12g Luxury Oud / 3ml oil / Flamme Rouge Perfume

products.title: Ryu Senshi
products.body_html:
Today I bring you a different experience, something luxurious, a rich trio I designed with the most precious and unique elements that are bound to ignite a fearless warrior within. A perfume, oil, and pure natural agarwood. At the heart of this trio is a wild rare Borneo oud sitting on a bed of musky, leathery, saffron notes and other exquisite ouds, all complemented together with a cloud of rich smoke that will make any person stand out from the crowd.

 

Contains: 12g luxury Oud / 3ml oil / katana Perfuim

products.title: Rose Mystère
products.body_html: A new exhilarating journey that will carry your olfactory on a hypnotic adventure. A combo of scents designed and chosen precisely to complement you in a way you’ve never imagined. Rose Mystère, a compendium of enriched ouds and roses enveloped in a cloud of precious Indian smoke and complemented with my perfume Coraćao de Rosas. This trio is a gift to your senses.

products.title: Cuban Smoke
products.body_html:
A Cuban fumes voyage pulling your senses into burning tobacco leaves wrapped with an extract of special, rare and sweet ouds. This is truly a Byzantine experience with aromas of amber, black pepper, tobacco leaves surrounded by burning oud smoke and coupled with my perfume Tabaco Cubano giving you an experience not to be forgotten.

Contains: 12g luxury Oud / 3ml oil / Tabaco Cubano Perfume

products.title: Oud Tabaco Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: This perfume was designed with a core depth of two exquisite notes: tobacco and rare pure oud oils to bring a synergy of luxury like no other. An extravagant fragrance composed with leather, tobacco, amber, unique spices, ouds and musks. If you are a lover of my signature Katana creation, then this perfume is certainly a must have.

products.title: Katana Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: The scent of a fearless warrior charging through the woods to his next destiny. This perfume is composed of a rare wild Borneo oud heart that sits beautifully on top of an accord of oud oils from all around the globe, infused with a musky leathery saffron blood note that is bound to make any person stand out from the crowd.

products.title: Flor Del Mati Parfum
products.body_html: Breathe the new morning scent wih Flor Del Matí, a garland of aromatic full-bloomed peonies harmonizing with an invigorating coffee savour. This captivating fragrance takes you on a sensory journey between the delicate, morning-crisp flower scent and earthy java notes, entrapping your senses in a sumptuous aromatic experience.

products.title: Sabaku Nomad Parfum
products.body_html: A unique approach on oriental/arabian perfumery. by far the most complex formula i have ever designed, its woody, smoky, ambery, sweet notes standout amongst a vast array of constituents slowly evolving to represent precious memories in my life.

products.title: Dōkutsu Kanam Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Ignited from my deep love for oud and cardamom, this complex composition of spices gently softened with vanilla and tonka notes laying on a bed of the finest quality oud oils is breathtaking. Dōkutsu meaning ‘cave’ refers directly to a cave called Kanam in the heart of Cardamom mountain, situated in the midst of the agarwood jungles of Cambodia.

products.title: Moya Kvitka Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: A tuberose explosion that teases your senses. Designed without using any actual tuberose, this perfume is my recreation of the flower using raw materials and an oriental base of resins toppled with a spicy note of star anise to give a very fragrant and evolving scent on your skin. A must have for any tuberose lover.

products.title: Coração De Rosas Parfum
products.body_html: This is my first ever perfume creation. Designed with love and passion for someone dear to my heart, I created this floral perfume using a variety of flowers and roses trying to emulate the true essence of a unique rose. The perfume contains the richest of oils and absolutes, projecting a soft sexy floral scent that draws everyone nearer to it.

products.title: Tobaco Cubano Parfum
products.body_html: A rustic luxurious perfume that beats with a heart of rich tobacco and aged leather with notes of amber and black pepper, it’s made to turn heads at every occasion. This unisex perfume is one of our most complemented creations at Oud Factory. we highly recommend it coupled with its Oud oil counterpart for complete synergy.

products.title: Fumo Dolce Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: A sweet and mysterious fragrance ‘Fumo Dolce’ is a creamy Oud enriched with royal notes of Omani frankincense. The gourmand presence of the scent is intensified by cocoa/ vanilla accords framed with white oak and opoponax. Infused with pure Oud oils it gives an ultimate and unique olfactory experience that will leve you in awe.

products.title: Flamme Rouge Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Faith is the fire that lights all flames. ‘Flamme Rouge’ is a perfume that speaks about the raw love of pure Oud inspired by Middle Eastern traditions that cherish the rare and precious fire of saffron, balanced with nuances of musk and oak moss and Inspired by the passion of flying through flames; you will discover a scent like no other.

products.title: IL Mio Cuore Parfum
products.body_html: The unseen human soul is the spirit life that defines the person carrying it. This perfume I designed to represent myself as a person, to represent my heart “il Mio Cuore”. with a vanilla, floral opening, and a musky core it is by far one of the longest lasting perfumes i have ever created.

products.title: Kodokuna Heishi v2 Oud Oil
products.body_html: a uniquely designed oud oil (only) concoction from the rarest types of wild agarwood around the world. this limited edition features high grade wild silani, wild borneo, and many other high grade oils. Kodokuna Heishi v2 is a must have for every oud collector.

products.title: Black Dragon Oil
products.body_html: A dark rich Oud/Deer Musk concoction that will leave you baffled by its unique notes. For years I’ve wanted to design an animalic perfume that is not so pungent in character nor overwhelming to the senses. Black Dragon is a plethora of hidden gems that can only be described as a true mystery.

products.title: IL Mio Cuore Oil
products.body_html: The unseen human soul is the spirit life that defines the person carrying it. This oil I designed to represent myself as a person, to represent my heart “il Mio Cuore”. with a vanilla, floral opening, and a musky core it is by far one of the longest lasting perfumes i have ever created.

products.title: Flamme Rouge Oil
products.body_html: Faith is the fire that lights all flames. ‘Flamme Rouge’ is an oil perfume that speaks about the raw love of pure Oud inspired by Middle Eastern traditions that cherish the rare and precious fire of saffron, balanced with nuances of musk and oak moss and Inspired by the passion of flying through flames; you will discover a scent like no other.

products.title: Fumo Dolce Oil
products.body_html: A sweet and mysterious fragrance ‘Fumo Dolce’ is a creamy Oud enriched with royal notes of Omani frankincense. The gourmand presence of the scent is intensified by cocoa/ vanilla accords framed with white oak and opoponax. Infused with pure Oud oils it gives an ultimate and unique olfactory experience that will leave you in awe.

products.title: Senshi Oud Oil
products.body_html: (Warrior in Japanese) is quickly becoming my favorite oud oil of all time. Designed using pure oud oils from all around the world, it slowly evolves taking your mind from one place to another. It's very fragrant, long lasting and it's beauty truly overwhelms your senses.

products.title: Katana Oil
products.body_html: The scent of a fearless warrior charging through the woods to his next destiny. This oil is composed of a rare wild Borneo oud heart that sits beautifully on top of an accord of oud oils from all around the globe, infused with a musky leathery saffron blood note that is bound to make any person stand out from the crowd.

products.title: Deer Musk Oil
products.body_html: Composed of four different agarwood oils mixed with a pure deer musk infusion, high quality Kashmirian saffron infusion, and a touch of Rosa Damascena essential oil. This is a beauty to own and have Very powerful and fragrant.

products.title: Tabaco Cubano Oil
products.body_html: Tabaco Cubano Oil. a rustic luxurious oud symphony that beats with a heart of rich tobacco and aged leather notes made to turn heads at every occasion. This unisex perfume is one of our best creations at Oud Factory.

products.title: Rosa Escura Oil
products.body_html: Inspired by my previous creation Coracao de Rosas to bring something to my oud lovers that harmonises between the rusky dark rich oud notes and this sexy flowery explosion of emotion and pure love. Rosa Escura (Dark Rose) was born.

products.title: Seufi Oud Oil
products.body_html: A blend of 100% pure oud/agarwood oils with the primary oil being Indian. It is quite common to think Seufi oil is some kind of special tree, or cultivart, while in reality it is a name meaning "High Quality".

products.title: Wild Borneo Oud Oil
products.body_html: 100% pure wild Borneo agarwood oil from the region of Sabah. Considered one of the richest and most luxorious oils in the world as it is produced from natural agar infected wild trees not cultivated ones.

products.title: Indian Oud Oil
products.body_html: 100% Pure Indian agarwood oil. This oil has a distinct animalic high note that clears within 20 mintes. The smell changes overtime to be quite beautiful and unique and is quite long lasting.
